definitions.gloss: terrible at, very bad at, clumsy
definitions.explanation: An emphatic, rude form of {下手|へた}, meaning extremely unskilled or bad at something. Stronger and more colloquial than {下手|へた} alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下手|へた}くそだ。
⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下手|へた}くそで、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦エンスト→エンスト：29983_ensuto⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His driving was so bad that he stalled the engine multiple times.

notes:
REGISTER:
Rude and blunt. Used when criticizing someone's skill harshly, often in casual speech or as a taunt. Avoid in polite settings.

FORMS:
⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧ (unskilled) + ⟦くそ→くそ：10783_kuso⟧ (intensifier from {糞|くそ}, a vulgar suffix meaning "crappy")

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: unskilled (neutral)
- {下手|へた}くそ: terrible at (rude, emphatic)
- ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧: clumsy, not dexterous (more neutral, broader)
